references.text: Describes the encirclement by evil men and is compared to lions, which can be seen as a prediction of the event in Matthew where Jesus is surrounded by those who crucify him alongside him, including the thieves.
Paul urges believers not only to be good when observed, contrasting with the actions of the thieves mentioned in Matthew; their deeds were openly evil even in their final moments.
The prophecy that the Messiah will be counted among lawbreakers, which is fulfilled in Matthew when Jesus is crucified alongside two thieves.
